answer: Resist sybils with a ferrous bond-and-prune gate: each new agent locks a non-transferable stake that only thaws after a 14-day garden of peer challenges, where random incumbents issue cheap puzzles the claimant must solve on-ledger. Clones fail cost asymmetry—attackers pay N times the bond while defenders spend near-zero. Final admission needs a summit of 7 distinct established attestors from separate invite lineages; shared roots auto-slash the bond. Reputation alone is ignored; the ledger tracks lineage graphs and burns failed claimants.
